title: manage mcp servers / Edit an MCP server configuration
content: ## Edit an MCP server configuration To edit an existing server, [open the server controls](#open-the-server-controls): 1. In **MCP Servers** in the Agent Customizations editor, select the server from the list. 1. Change the server type or fields: command, arguments, and environment variables for stdio, or URL and headers for HTTP. 1. Select **Save**. If a value isn't supported by the destination file, **Save** is unavailable and the form explains what to change. Select **Discard Changes** to restore saved values. Saving preserves unchanged file content and properties the form doesn't display, such as `tools`. Select **Other Properties** to open the entry in its source JSON file. Enter arguments as a space-separated string or a JSON array of strings. With focus in the form, press `kbstyle(Alt+F1)` (`kbstyle(Option+F1)` on macOS) to open Accessibility Help. ![Screenshot showing the MCP server configuration form for a workspace-root .mcp.json server.](../../agent-customization/images/mcp-servers/mcp-server-configuration-form.png) Portable configurations support form editing. {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} formats appear as read-only JSON, so edit their source file instead. Check the [configuration file comparison](/docs/agents/reference/mcp-configuration.md#configuration-file) for supported fields and forwarding restrictions. Legacy destinations can still be necessary for {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}-specific capabilities.
